name: Bleeding Channel
body:
When you channel negative energy to harm a living creature, dozens of tiny gashes slice into the creature’s skin, spilling its blood. These wounds are resistant to mundane healing.

Prerequisite(s): Channel negative energy 2d6 class feature, must have studied Memory Shards

Benefit(s): When you channel to harm living creatures, myriad cuts open on the victim’s skin. If a creature fails its Will save, it takes an amount of bleed damage equal to 1/2 the number of dice of damage your channeled negative energy deals.

Legendary Classes: Defenders of the Faith © 2024, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Aaron Hollingsworth, Amber Scott, Andrew J. Gibson, Carl Cramer, Clinton J. Boomer, Connor Bates, Jenny Jarzabski, Margherita Tramontano, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke, and Norman Mitchell Jr.
